_note: The ground duel without a die (ADR-042 §3 and §5, core, maintainer's go 2026-11-12). An opponent within reach_cm of the ball challenges the carrier, at most once every retry_ticks (his own pace); the contact is deterministic: the defender's force is a weighted sum of his tackling and explosive force, the carrier's of his first touch (keeping the ball, a proxy until dribbling exists) and explosive force; the stronger contact wins, ties to the carrier. If the defender wins, the ball is his. Declared distance from ADR-042: no body control, maximal force, posture or point of impact yet (the latents do not exist), no foul band. ADR-042 accepted and amended (2026-11-13), step (a): the defender chooses how to go in. Standing (standing_salience x (0.5 + 0.5 x tackling)), slide (slide_salience x aggressiveness; it reaches slide_reach_milli of the standing reach and adds slide_bonus to his force, but if he does not win the ball he is on the ground for slide_recovery_ticks), or jockey (jockey_salience x (1 - aggressiveness) x (0.5 + 0.5 x game_reading): he stays in front and waits, no contact). The forces read the new roots: the defender's tackling, explosive force, maximal_force, body_control; the carrier's first touch (keeping the ball, until dribbling enters with the carrier's answer), explosive force, maximal_force, body_control. Four outcomes: the defender wins if his force exceeds the carrier's by more than loose_margin; the carrier keeps it if his exceeds by more than loose_margin (ties to the carrier); in between the ball comes loose, pushed at loose_speed away from the defender. The foul (Law 12) is step (b).
_source: Arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3. reach 120 cm: a leg's reach with a step; retry 30 ticks: a defender challenges again after about 3 s, and the carrier who loses the ball waits as long before he can win it back (no instant ping-pong). The new weights and the three saliences: arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3 against real duel and tackle success rates.
